title: Spiritual Journey to Kandy: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
seoTitle: Kandy Temple of the Tooth: A Spiritual Journey | Tourvir
description: Immerse yourself in the cultural heart of Sri Lanka and discover the sacred Temple of the Tooth.
author: Tourvir Team
introduction: Kandy, the last royal capital of Sri Lanka, is nestled among misty hills and tea plantations.

sections.heading: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
paragraphs: The crown jewel of Kandy is the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, also known as Sri Dalada Maligawa, which houses a tooth relic of the Buddha.
Exploring the temple complex offers a glimpse into Buddhist rituals and traditional Kandyan architecture.

sections.heading: Add Kandy to a Sri Lanka Itinerary
paragraphs: A walk around Kandy Lake can complement a visit to the temple complex.
